user.title: MeteoSwiss Rain-Start
user.description:
Samples the MeteoSwiss precipitation radar at your pin (about 1 km cells, 5-minute steps). Type a location name. That name labels the device.

Parser problem stays off while the unofficial radar JSON decodes. When that flag is on, parse_ok is false. Ignore the rain sensors. They are unavailable.

What to do when Parser problem is on:
1. Open the entity and read parse_detail.
2. Open the MeteoSwiss precipitation map. If the map is down, wait.
3. If the map works, the JSON or legend changed. Check the Home Assistant log.
4. Update radar_nowcast.py, deploy, and restart Home Assistant. Reload is not enough.
5. After a good poll the flag turns off. Dismiss the notification.

A network error does not set this flag. It only leaves the rain sensors unavailable.

data_description.location: Pin the house. Coverage is Switzerland only.
data_description.location_name: A name you type. Used on the device and in entity names.
data_description.threshold_mm: Rate that counts as rain. The radar uses legend bins, not exact millimetres.
data_description.poll_interval: How often Home Assistant downloads the radar JSON (60 to 3600 seconds).

error.outside_switzerland: Location is outside Switzerland radar coverage.
error.invalid_location: Choose a location on the map.
error.name_required: Enter a name for this location.
error.threshold_invalid: Threshold must be between 0 and 100 mm/h.
error.poll_interval_invalid: Poll interval must be between 60 and 3600 seconds.

parser_problem.title: MeteoSwiss Rain-Start: radar parse failed
parser_problem.message:
Rain-start for {location_name} can no longer parse the MeteoSwiss radar nowcast ({detail}). Ignore the other sensors. They are unavailable.

1. Open Parser problem and read parse_detail.
2. Check that the MeteoSwiss precipitation map still loads.
3. If the map works, the unofficial JSON or colours changed. Check the log, fix radar_nowcast.py, deploy, and restart Home Assistant.
parser_problem.what_to_do: Ignore the rain sensors. Read parse_detail. If the MeteoSwiss precipitation map still loads, the unofficial JSON changed. Fix radar_nowcast.py, deploy, and restart Home Assistant.
